name: Differential old/new evaluator, five DIRECT fields (allowed_actions, allowed_adapters, allowed_units, allowed_institutions, allowed_authority_domains)
basis: Refusal oracles for all five allowlists exist (Q04). No test builds a policy from a registry record; no grid; no deny-all test.

name: max_amount differential (conditional on D6 and a code hard cap) [INACTIVE: max_amount deferred, not in V1]
basis: max_amount is deferred and not in V1. Existing C11[max_amount], C16, C18 stay as they are. Reported inactive, never PASS.

name: F4 status_max_age_seconds and approval_max_age_seconds differential
basis: Adjacent tests exist for the boundary pattern and current bounds (Q06) and the current fixed approval window (TC-L06-015). No configurable or registry-narrowed approval-age test, no registry-narrowed bound, no extension-ceiling test.

name: F5 ActionClass.max_status_age_seconds differential
basis: Thin: two references. TC-L05-013 is NOT_RUN and cannot detect the bounded_tolerance toggle (GAP-G4-05).

name: Configuration change tests (selection, supersession, rollback, epoch)
basis: No qualification-repository test. Builder tests in the registry repo use a FakeVerifier.

name: Required-policy refusal
basis: Thin: TC-L05-013 only. Builder tests are at decision-function level, none at an effect boundary.

name: Scope narrowing, never widening
basis: Builder tests only, 2 to 3 values per field. Consumer path has no caller.

name: Revocation and expiry
basis: Authority-level revocation and expiry well covered (Q09). No selection-level test.

name: Atomic effect-boundary tests
basis: Atomic authority boundary covered (Q08). Not registry policy at that boundary; policy check runs outside the transaction (GAP-G3-02).

name: Cross-component policy consistency
basis: Thin: MVP chain rows are builder proposals; no test compares Runtime-effective policy with Control Plane policy for registry values.

name: Evidence and replay verification
basis: Refusal and evidence substitution tests exist (Q12). None carries a registry record or selection identity.

name: Independent negative tests
basis: Thin: v1-probes and fix2-probes KNOWN_GAP rows are limits, not protection. No independent adversarial run.

name: Regression and disclosure
basis: Most existing tests are reusable for a rerun at exact pins. 11 undeclared Runtime known-limit tests and GAP-G4-09 come first.

name: Process: exact-head independent run by designated owner
basis: Process gate. No independent lead designated (GAP-G4-13).
